The f64 function check is consumed only when listed in checks_performed; MXCSR control state and NaN payload bits remain not performed. success_criteria: report.json carries mumei.native-machine-tv-recheck-report/v1 with machine_tv_recheck == 'checked'; Core checks_performed contains machine_code_f64_scalar_function_tv and the agent discharges it; Core and agent checks_not_performed contain machine_code_tv_mxcsr_control_state and machine_code_tv_nan_payload_bits, and neither is discharged; the register convention is copied verbatim; entry-wrapper and callee-saved checks are discharged only if Core lists them in checks_performed; Core lists os_exit_status_observation as not performed and the agent does not discharge it; object_translation_correspondence is not discharged; fadd, feq, and mixed do not appear in the report.
wrong_report.json has no machine_tv_recheck or discharged_checks, normalized.exit_code is nonzero, the sequence has no selected_result, and no f64 machine-TV check is discharged.

steps.name: Build the scalar-f64 bundle
steps.command: {mumei_bin} native-bundle build {root_dir}/scenarios/native_machine_tv_f64_recheck/src/main.mm -o {output_dir}/bundle > {output_dir}/build.log 2>&1 && python3 -c "import hashlib,json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json')); p=r['link_build']; empty=hashlib.sha256(b'').hexdigest(); assert p['expected_exit_status']==0, p; assert p['expected_stdout_sha256']==empty, p; assert p['expected_stderr_sha256']==empty, p; print(hashlib.sha256(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json','rb').read()).hexdigest())" > {output_dir}/build_id.txt; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/build.log; cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt; test $rc -eq 0
steps.artifact_contract: The bundle is built from the exact scalar-f64 fixture; its recorded execution exits 0 with empty stdout/stderr, and build_id.txt holds sha256(native-bundle.json).
steps.verifier_gate: Core builds the exact scalar-f64 source and the native bundle pins the expected process exit and output channels.

steps.name: Recheck scalar-f64 machine TV
steps.command: {mumei_bin} native-bundle recheck-machine-tv --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --json {output_dir}/bundle {root_dir}/scenarios/native_machine_tv_f64_recheck/src/main.mm > {output_dir}/core_descriptor.json && {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-machine-tv-recheck --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_machine_tv_f64_recheck/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --output {output_dir}/report.json > {output_dir}/recheck.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/report.json; cat {output_dir}/recheck.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; c=json.load(open('{output_dir}/core_descriptor.json')); r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/report.json')); performed=set(c['checks_performed']); discharged=set(r['discharged_checks']); f64='machine_code_f64_scalar_function_tv'; markers={'machine_code_tv_mxcsr_control_state','machine_code_tv_nan_payload_bits'}; convention='sysv_x86_64_integer_args_rdi_rsi_rdx_rcx_r8_r9_f64_args_xmm0_7_result_rax_or_xmm0'; assert f64 in performed and f64 in discharged, (c,r); assert markers <= set(c['checks_not_performed']), c; assert markers <= set(r['checks_not_performed']) and not (markers & discharged), r; external='machine_code_callee_saved_preservation_assumed_for_external_callees'; assert external not in discharged, r; assert r['register_convention_assumed']==convention==c['register_convention_assumed'], (c,r); assert 'os_exit_status_observation' in c['checks_not_performed'], c; assert 'os_exit_status_observation' not in discharged and 'object_translation_correspondence' not in discharged, r; assert all((check in performed)==(check in discharged) for check in ('machine_code_entry_wrapper_tv','machine_code_callee_saved_register_preservation')), (c,r); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-machine-tv-recheck-report/v1' and r['machine_tv_recheck']=='checked', r; assert r['machine_tv_schema']=='mumei.machine-code-tv/v1' and r['expected_build_id']==open('{output_dir}/build_id.txt').read().strip(), r; text=json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True); assert all(name not in text for name in ('fadd','feq','mixed')), text; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None; assert 'candidate' not in r; print('scalar-f64 check performed and discharged; MXCSR/NaN checks remain not performed')"
steps.artifact_contract: Core's raw descriptor and agent report list the scalar-f64 check as performed and discharged; MXCSR control state and NaN payload checks remain not performed; the XMM register-convention string is preserved, OS exit-status observation and object_translation_correspondence are not discharged, and function names are absent.
steps.verifier_gate: The matching Core descriptor lists machine_code_f64_scalar_function_tv in checks_performed; the agent discharges only that bounded check and does not claim IEEE-754, ABI, runtime, or OS exit-status behavior.

steps.name: Reject a mismatched build ID
steps.command: {mumei_bin} native-bundle recheck-machine-tv --expected-build-id $(python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest())") --json {output_dir}/bundle {root_dir}/scenarios/native_machine_tv_f64_recheck/src/main.mm > {output_dir}/wrong_core.log 2>&1; core_rc=$?; {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-machine-tv-recheck --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_machine_tv_f64_recheck/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest())") --output {output_dir}/wrong_report.json > {output_dir}/wrong.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/wrong_core.log; cat {output_dir}/wrong_report.json; cat {output_dir}/wrong.log; test $core_rc -ne 0 && test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import hashlib,json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/wrong_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-machine-tv-recheck-report/v1'; assert 'machine_tv_recheck' not in r and not r.get('discharged_checks'), r; assert r['expected_build_id']==hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest(), r; assert r['normalized'].get('exit_code') != 0, r['normalized']; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is None, r; assert 'machine_code_f64_scalar_function_tv' in r['checks_not_performed'], r; print('wrong build ID: Core exited nonzero and no machine-TV checks were discharged')"
steps.artifact_contract: The raw Core command exits nonzero; wrong_report.json has no machine-TV outcome or discharges, a nonzero normalized child exit, and no selected result.
steps.verifier_gate: A mismatched expected build ID is rejected by Core and produces no claimed machine-TV outcome.
